differences.current_text: I PAUL and Sylvanus and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians, which is in God the Father and in our Lord Yeshua the Messiah: Grace be with you, and peace.
differences.source_text: I PAUL and Sylvanus and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians, which is in God the Father and in our Lord Jesus the Messiah: Grace be with you, and peace.

differences.current_text: and we call to mind before God the Father the works of your faith, and the toil of your love, and the patience of your hope in our Lord Yeshua the Messiah.
differences.source_text: and we call to mind before God the Father the works of your faith, and the toil of your love, and the patience of your hope in our Lord Jesus the Messiah.

differences.current_text: while ye wait for his Son from heaven, that Yeshua whom he raised from the dead, who delivereth us from the wrath to come.
differences.source_text: while ye wait for his Son from heaven, that Jesus whom he raised from the dead, who delivereth us from the wrath to come.

differences.current_text: For ye, my brethren, became assimilated to the churches of God in Judaea, the persons who are in Yeshua the Messiah; in that ye so suffered, even ye from your own countrymen, as also they from the Jews,
differences.source_text: For ye, my brethren, became assimilated to the churches of God in Judaea, the persons who are in Jesus the Messiah; in that ye so suffered, even ye from your own countrymen, as also they from the Jews,

differences.current_text: the persons who slew our Lord Yeshua the Messiah, and persecuted their own prophets and us; and they please not God, and are made hostile to all men;
differences.source_text: the persons who slew our Lord Jesus the Messiah, and persecuted their own prophets and us; and they please not God, and are made hostile to all men;

differences.current_text: For what is our hope, and our joy, and the crown of our glorying; unless it be ye, before our Lord Yeshua at his coming?
differences.source_text: For what is our hope, and our joy, and the crown of our glorying; unless it be ye, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

differences.current_text: And may God our Father, and our Lord Yeshua the Messiah, direct our way unto you;
differences.source_text: And may God our Father, and our Lord Jesus the Messiah, direct our way unto you;

differences.current_text: and establish your hearts unblamable in holiness, before God our Father; at the advent of our Lord Yeshua the Messiah, with all his saints.
differences.source_text: and establish your hearts unblamable in holiness, before God our Father; at the advent of our Lord Jesus the Messiah, with all his saints.

differences.current_text: Wherefore, my brethren, I entreat you, and beseech you by our Lord Yeshua, that, as ye have received from us how ye ought to walk, and to please God, so ye would make progress more and more.
differences.source_text: Wherefore, my brethren, I entreat you, and beseech you by our Lord Jesus, that, as ye have received from us how ye ought to walk, and to please God, so ye would make progress more and more.

differences.current_text: For ye know what command we gave you in our Lord Yeshua the Messiah.
differences.source_text: For ye know what command we gave you in our Lord Jesus the Messiah.

differences.current_text: For if we believe that Yeshua died and rose again, even so them who sleep, will God, by Yeshua, bring with him.
differences.source_text: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them who sleep, will God, by Jesus, bring with him.

differences.current_text: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to the acquisition of life, by our Lord Yeshua the Messiah:
differences.source_text: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to the acquisition of life, by our Lord Jesus the Messiah:

differences.current_text: And in every thing be thankful: For this is the pleasure of God in Yeshua the Messiah, concerning you.
differences.source_text: And in every thing be thankful: For this is the pleasure of God in Jesus the Messiah, concerning you.

differences.current_text: And may the God of peace sanctify you all, perfectly, and keep blameless your whole spirit, and your soul, and your body, till the coming of our Lord Yeshua the Messiah.
differences.source_text: And may the God of peace sanctify you all, perfectly, and keep blameless your whole spirit, and your soul, and your body, till the coming of our Lord Jesus the Messiah.

differences.current_text: The grace of our Lord Yeshua the Messiah be with you. Amen.
differences.source_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus the Messiah be with you. Amen.
